profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Northrop Grumman Corporation
profile.summary: Extensive depth and progressive experience in software design, development, integration, and test in aerospace and defense industry programs. Led and managed teams of varying scope while providing senior level software development skills to each team.  Technical strengths include safety critical mission systems operational aircraft flight software, spacecraft payload flight software, object-oriented system analysis and design, high fidelity real-time flight simulation, test set development, and software process management.  Strong communication and leadership skills combine with history of technical experience to provide excellent foundation as both valuable team leader and individual contributor as exemplified with several awards and technical publications.
